targetTexts.1: A Maskil of Asaph. Why have You rejected us forever, O God? Why does Your anger smolder against the sheep of Your pasture?
targetTexts.2: Remember Your congregation, which You purchased long ago and redeemed as the tribe of Your inheritance—Mount Zion, where You dwell.
targetTexts.3: Turn Your steps to the everlasting ruins, to everything in the sanctuary the enemy has destroyed.
targetTexts.4: Your foes have roared within Your meeting place; they have unfurled their banners as signs,
targetTexts.5: like men wielding axes in a thicket of trees
targetTexts.6: and smashing all the carvings with hatchets and picks.
targetTexts.7: They have burned Your sanctuary to the ground; they have defiled the dwelling place of Your Name.
targetTexts.8: They said in their hearts, “We will crush them completely.” They burned down every place where God met us in the land.
targetTexts.9: There are no signs for us to see. There is no longer any prophet. And none of us knows how long this will last.
targetTexts.10: How long, O God, will the enemy taunt You? Will the foe revile Your name forever?
targetTexts.11: Why do You withdraw Your strong right hand? Stretch it out to destroy them!
targetTexts.12: Yet God is my King from ancient times, working salvation on the earth.
targetTexts.13: You divided the sea by Your strength; You smashed the heads of the dragons of the sea;
targetTexts.14: You crushed the heads of Leviathan; You fed him to the creatures of the desert.
targetTexts.15: You broke open the fountain and the flood; You dried up the ever-flowing rivers.
targetTexts.16: The day is Yours, and also the night; You established the moon and the sun.
targetTexts.17: You set all the boundaries of the earth; You made the summer and winter.
targetTexts.18: Remember how the enemy has mocked You, O LORD, how a foolish people has spurned Your name.
targetTexts.19: Do not deliver the soul of Your dove to beasts; do not forget the lives of Your afflicted forever.
targetTexts.20: Consider Your covenant, for haunts of violence fill the dark places of the land.
targetTexts.21: Do not let the oppressed retreat in shame; may the poor and needy praise Your name.
targetTexts.22: Rise up, O God; defend Your cause! Remember how the fool mocks You all day long.
targetTexts.23: Do not disregard the clamor of Your adversaries, the uproar of Your enemies that ascends continually.
